➢ New Map (Location): Devil's Palm

➢ New Stands!

 TRADING SYSTEM

Welcome to The Lost Adventures, engage in fast paced fights against other players and discover different play-styles trough our vast choice of abilities and combos!
The Lost Adventures is heavily inspired by Hirohiko Araki's work titled Jojo's Bizarre Adventure and includes sound effects from its anime.
VIEW OUR SOCIALS FOR CODES, SNEAKS, UPDATES AND ANNOUNCEMENTS ABOUT THE GAME.

➢ 2x cash every Friday Saturday & Sunday

➢ You will be banned if you are caught cheating or exploiting, as such it is recommended to record your gameplay with software like "Medal" or "Shadowplay".
